model_source: Original sampler: one MPY plus seven MACs (eight products); source prose claiming nine is contradicted by its instructions. Phase folding from blofeld-src/doc/dsp_sample_stream.txt; DSP56300FM Rev5 IFcc and word-transfer semantics.
qualification: Unmodified isolated sampler under explicit slot, ring, FM, linear coefficient addressing and unscaled arithmetic inputs. Logical WPC PCM windows are supplied as declared high-aligned ring words; no physical NAND/header mapping, install, boot, scheduling, resampler rate preparation or physical audio equivalence.
